title: Moho animated value ("channel")
description: Almost every numeric/colour/boolean/string property in a Moho document is stored as this one repeated structure - confirmed 201,185+ instances across the reverse-engineering sample set (see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §5). A field that is never animated may instead appear as a bare scalar or plain object (see ChannelOrPlain below) - Moho accepts both forms transparently.

InterpEntry.description: One entry of a channel's interp[] array, one per keyframe, describing the interpolation of the segment LEAVING that keyframe. moho2svg.py ignores this entirely and always interpolates linearly - exact at keyframes, approximate between them. The meaning of t/im/in/s/h is NOT decoded; only the observed value sets are recorded here. See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §5.3.

t.description: Interpolation type. Observed: 0 (208,858+ of ~all entries, overwhelming default), 4, 2, 6, 1. Meaning not decoded. Non-zero values appear almost exclusively on pose/anim_pos/anim_angle/anim_scale/physics_motor_speed.

s.description: Not decoded. Observed false in every sampled entry.

h.description: Not decoded. Observed 0 in every sampled entry.

v1.description: Not decoded. Commonly 0.1 (an apparently-unused default); also -1, 15.

b.description: Rare (observed on <20 entries total, only alongside t==4). Explicit Bezier-like handles for the timing curve itself, one object per control point.

ActionRef.description: One entry of a channel's actions[] list: this channel takes its value from `pose` instead of its own when/val while the Smart Bone dial named `name` is active. `pose` is itself a full channel of the SAME type as the parent channel, but keyed by "pose-curve position" rather than by document frame - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §11 and §5.4 for how the active pose-frame is found (inverting the pose curve against the dial's own current angle).

name.description: An action name, matched against a registry on some ancestor BoneLayer's own `actions` list. If this name also matches a bone's own name in the same skeleton, that bone is the "dial" whose angle drives this override; otherwise this pose is dormant (this tool only activates the dial kind).

_ChannelBase.description: Fields common to every channel regardless of `type`. `when`, `val`, and `interp` are always exactly the same length (verified with zero exceptions across the entire sample set).

ref.description: Observed false on every sampled channel. Meaning not decoded.

mute.description: Disables the channel when true. Observed false on every sampled channel - untested whether this tool's evaluator (which ignores it) would misbehave on a genuinely muted channel.

when.description: Keyframe frame numbers, ascending. Length always equals val's and interp's.

actions.description: Smart Bone action overrides for this channel. Present on a small minority of channels (observed ~2% of all channels in the sample set, concentrated on mesh point positions and bone transforms).

split.description: Vec2/Vec3 channels only, and rare (observed exactly once in the reverse-engineering sample set). One independent Val sub-channel per axis (Moho's "separate the x/y curves" feature). moho2svg.py does not read this - it evaluates the parent Vec2/Vec3 arrays directly, which could go stale if an axis is keyframed differently from its parent. See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §5.4.

ValChannel.description: A single-float channel. By far the most common channel type (423,642+ instances in the reverse-engineering sample set). Used for curve-point smoothness/weight/offset, mesh point width, bone anim_angle/anim_scale, line_width, and many more.

ColorChannel.description: An RGBA colour channel (components are floats in 0.0-1.0, NOT the 0-255 integers used by a few plain non-channel colour fields like project_data.back_color). Used for fill_color, line_color, mesh point vertex colour.

Vec2Channel.description: A 2D vector channel. Used for mesh point position, bone anim_pos, effect_offset, ik_parent_target, camera_pan_tilt.

Vec3Channel.description: A 3D vector channel. Used for transforms.translation/.scale/.shear and camera_track. moho2svg.py is a 2D exporter and ignores the z component of translation/scale.

BoolChannel.description: A boolean channel. Used for flip_h/flip_v, layer_effects.visibility, ik_lock, bone_dynamics, on/off toggles throughout layer_effects/layer_shadow/etc.

StringChannel.description: A string channel. Used for switch_keys (child layer names), shape_order, layer_ordering, timeline_markers.

Channel.description: A channel of any of the six observed types. Prefer the specific *Channel $defs (ValChannel, ColorChannel, ...) wherever the expected type is known from context - this generic union exists for places (e.g. an action's pose, a split axis) where the type must match whatever the sibling/parent channel already uses.
